results.doc_title: Bearing Wear and Overheating — Diagnostic Guide
results.text: Elevated bearing temperature combined with increased vibration amplitude is the classic signature of bearing wear or insufficient lubrication. Normal operating temperature for CB-4400 bearings is 60-75C with vibration under 1.0 mm/s RMS. Sustained readings above 85C accompanied by vibration exceeding 1.2 mm/s RMS indicate advanced bearing degradation. Root causes include grease starvation, contaminant ingress, misalignment, or end-of-life wear. Recommended action: schedule immediate inspection;

results.doc_title: Distinguishing Sensor Fault from Real Equipment Fault
results.text: Before acting on an anomalous reading, rule out sensor fault: a genuine equipment problem produces a gradual trend over minutes to hours, while a sensor fault often produces a sudden step-change or a reading stuck at a fixed value. If a suspected fault reading has not shown a gradual precursor trend, sensor malfunction should be considered alongside equipment failure.
